* [001 — Keep re-export shims for external peer deps - they dedupe esbuild bundle imports](entries/001.md) — esbuild emits one external-module import per source statement and never cross-file merges them, minified or not; a re-export shim collapses N consumers to one import. Don't delete such shims as pure indirection. · `triggers: delete-shim, re-export-barrel, esbuild-external, bundle-imports` · `tags: arch, bundling, dom` · `type: decision`
* [002 — prefetch writes `staleTime ?? Infinity` so cache hits do not fire SWR](entries/002.md) — resourceCache.prefetch passes `staleTime ?? Infinity` to setCacheData (not the raw option), matching resource()'s default; a resource that later reads the entry cache-hits with no background refetch. · `triggers: prefetch, staleTime, swr` · `tags: resource, cache` · `type: decision`
* [003 — Core is the shared utils/env kernel — re-exports are runtime-free under the bundle model, not a smell](entries/003.md) — @hellajs/core re-exports type guards (isFunction/isPlainObject/isString/isFalsy/isObject/objectLoop) and env probes (hasWindow/hasDocument/hasNavigator) from its barrel by design; guides/code.md sanctions it and consuming packages bundle core wholesale, so don't propose extracting them as responsibility drift. · `triggers: core-utils, utils-export, env-probes, shared-kernel, brain-critic-core` · `tags: arch, core` · `type: decision`

Dissolved in favor of a docs reframe. Re-plan only if a real user need surfaces. · `triggers: per-element-array-reactivity, store-comparison-gap, reactive-arrays, large-list-store` · `tags: arch, store, arrays, comparison-doc` · `type: decision`
* [005 — SSR readiness by package — core/store DOM-free, css platform-return BUILT, resource already server-safe, dom importable-but-inert, html``/babel AST is the DOM-free seam](entries/005.md) — Verified 2026-07-10, re-verified 2026-07-11. core + store have zero DOM refs. css has platform-dependent return (BUILT): css()/cssVars() return text on server with zero state mutation, name/proxy on client (css.ts:37, cssVars.ts:27-41). resource IS server-import-safe (hasDocument at internal/lifecycle.ts:34, hasNavigator/hasWindow at cache.ts:22-24) — an earlier grep-based 'unguarded' claim was wrong, corrected by reading guard context. dom imports cleanly (no module-scope DOM access) but mountNode is hardwired to document.createElement (internal/render.ts:88). html`` parser + babel plugin produce HellaNode ASTs with zero DOM refs — the DOM-free seam the BUILT @hellajs/ssr stringifier walks (see 013). · `triggers: ssr-readiness, ssr, hydration, ssr-audit` · `tags: arch, ssr, core, css, dom, resource` · `type: decision`
* [006 — SSR-css track: platform-dependent return — BUILT (css()/cssVars() return text on server, name/proxy on client)](entries/006.md) — BUILT and verified 2026-07-10. css() returns CSS text on server (css.ts:37 — if (!hasDocument()) return cssText), returns name on client. cssVars() returns vars text on server (cssVars.ts:27-41), proxy on client. Server path is stateless: css() early-returns before injectedMap; cssVars() before any state/effects. The former 4 css-side maps collapsed to 1 (injectedMap in cssStore.ts). The <style> babel transform is deleted. Six alternatives were rejected; platform-dependent return preserves cssVars client reactivity. Tested in tests/ssr.test.ts (13 tests). · `triggers: css-return-type, platform-return, style-transform, css-server, ssr-css` · `tags: arch, css, ssr, babel, breaking-change` · `type: decision`
* [008 — dom 'multiple components isolation' test is flaky in the full suite](entries/008.md) — packages/dom/tests/component.test.ts 'multiple components isolation' intermittently fails in full `bun coverage` (uncaught 'render failed') but passes in isolation (`bun coverage dom`) and on re-run — pre-existing cross-suite ordering/timing in dom's render-error dispatch, not a regression signal. Re-run before investigating. · `triggers: flaky-test, full-coverage-failure, dom-component-isolation` · `tags: testing, dom, flaky` · `type: decision`
* [010 — ssr() coalesces adjacent text; mount() separates it — the serialization contract diverges for reactive-text-adjacent-to-static-text](entries/010.md) — ssr() concatenates walkChild results with no separator, so adjacent static + resolved-reactive text become ONE DOM text node after parse; mount() appends a separate createTextNode per child + a persistent anchor per reactive child. Structures match only when an element boundary separates reactive text from static text. hydrate() rebuilds coalesced runs locally; element-bounded structure and ForEach-of-elements are adopted. Verified empirically 2026-07-10. · `triggers: ssr-coalescing, serialization-contract, ssr-mount-mismatch, hydration-text, adjacent-text` · `tags: arch, ssr, contract, hydration` · `type: decision`
* [011 — @hellajs/ssr is not in bun.lock/node_modules — cross-package test imports of ssr need a declared dep; dom tests simulate server HTML via mount→innerHTML](entries/011.md) — @hellajs/ssr was added to packages/ without a `bun install`, so it is absent from bun.lock and not linked into node_modules/@hellajs/. dom tests cannot `import { ssr } from '@hellajs/ssr/bundle'` (dom declares no dep on ssr) — 'Cannot find module'. The hydrate tests build server HTML via a `serverContainer` helper (mount → serialize innerHTML, which reproduces ssr text coalescing). Caveat: serverContainer diverges from ssr for Portal (mount populates the target), Lazy (mount fires the loader), and sync hooks (mount fires beforeMount) — use manual innerHTML for those. · `triggers: ssr-linkability, cross-package-test, cannot-find-module-ssr, serverContainer, bun-install` · `tags: testing, ssr, env, workspaces` · `type: decision`
* [012 — Reactive getters returning a bare isDynamic RenderFn are unsupported by ssr/hydrate (marker-free adoption limit)](entries/012.md) — A reactive child resolving to an isDynamic component fn (e.g. () => ForEach({...})) is stringified by ssr and cannot be adopted by hydrate; the obvious Proxy-mirror fix duplicates server nodes. Use the component as a direct child or wrap in a HellaNode. · `triggers: isdynamic-reactive-getter, ssr-walkchild, marker-free-adoption, hydrate-mounteractiveat` · `tags: arch, ssr, hydration, contract` · `type: decision`
* [013 — SSR + hydration use explicit <!--[-->…<!--]--> comment markers (marker-free walk reverted)](entries/013.md) — ssr() wraps every dynamic region (reactive child, isDynamic component, nested fragment) in Vue-style <!--[-->…<!--]--> markers; hydrate reads Comment nodes (nodeValue [ / ]) to locate regions. Reverts the marker-free cursor-walk design. · `triggers: ssr-markers, hydrate-marker-reader, marker-free-walk-reverted, hydration-contract` · `tags: arch, ssr, hydration, dom` · `type: decision`
